task: Add an opt-in retryOnAnyFailure manifest flag and extend the B-2941 pass-2 retry membership so allowlisted load-flake smokes also retry on a FAIL, while every non-allowlisted smoke keeps FAIL as terminal.
outcome: Developer runs npm run test:all. The 4 allowlisted load-flake smokes (field-regression-cli, verification-freshness, worktree-repair, review-pass-discard), if they FAIL under parallel load in pass 1, now appear in the pass-2 serial retry alongside timeouts and pass on retry — so the run ends Final N/N passed exit 0 deterministically across 3 consecutive runs. A non-allowlisted smoke that FAILs is still terminal (not retried), so a genuine regression still turns the suite red. CHANGELOG + docs document the opt-in flag, the 4 allowlisted smokes, and that this is a stopgap.
